title: VLM-labeled skeleton segments for coons cage blanks
description: Extend reference_scaffold to generate coons cages with named semantic segments. Extract skeleton from reference, render colored branches from 4 angles, send to VLM for anatomical labeling. Map labels to cage operations: trunk becomes main cage, child branches become extrusions or insets with semantic names like jaw_extrude or orbital_inset. The skeleton branch matching from MeshSkeletonComparator provides the link between reference branch labels and generated mesh branches — labels are assigned to the reference skeleton which is stable, then transferred via nearest-tip matching.
definition-of-done: reference_scaffold generates DSL with named sections matching skeleton branches. VLM labels are used for node naming. Generated DSL has comments explaining each section. skeleton_compare output uses the same labels.
testing-plan: Run reference_scaffold on skull.obj with VLM labeling. Verify generated DSL has named sections like jaw_extrude and cranium_cage. Verify skeleton_compare uses matching labels.
